verdict.rationale: Stripe Atlas is an incorporation service, so a compliance calendar with filing-deadline reminders is a fair axis to judge it on. The evidence pack never documents a deadline calendar or reminder feature. The only nearby mention is a community note about a setup checklist, which is an adjacent onboarding feature rather than a calendar with reminders, and another user reports getting no warnings about Delaware franchise tax.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can see a compliance calendar of upcoming filing deadlines and get reminders before each one
